caption: The drawing depicts a tall, rectangular grandfather clock with a wooden body colored in shades of reddish-brown. The clock case has four short legs that appear golden or brass colored. The upper section of the clock features a large circular white clock face with black Arabic numerals and two black clock hands, currently showing the time to be about 11:40. Immediately below the clock face, there is a decorative area with a white section bordered by dark green or gray shading, containing a smaller white oval with cursive writing inside that reads "S. Banfield, Roxbury." The clock’s top section includes ornate wooden fretwork in a reddish-brown color and three finials: one large finial at the top center and two smaller, spire-like finials flanking it. The background is plain and beige, and the drawing is bordered by faint pencil guide lines. There are some brown stains and two pink dots visible on the paper around the edges.
title: Clock
